description: This file implements binary search functions related to Git object IDs and hash table lookups, including functions for searching object IDs within sorted tables and hash-based lookup. It contains internal search algorithms used within Git's object storage system.

methods.name: uint32_t take2(const struct object_id * oid,size_t ofs)
methods.description: Extracts a 16-bit value from an object ID's hash array at a specified offset.

methods.name: int oid_pos(const struct object_id * oid,const void * table,size_t nr,oid_access_fn fn)
methods.description: Performs a binary search over a table of object IDs, returning the position of the target or insertion point.

methods.name: int bsearch_hash(const unsigned char * hash,const uint32_t * fanout_nbo,const unsigned char * table,size_t stride,uint32_t * result)
methods.description: Performs a binary search within a hash table to find the position of a hash value, used for Git object lookup.

ctags.signature: (const unsigned char * hash,const uint32_t * fanout_nbo,const unsigned char * table,size_t stride,uint32_t * result)
